[quote=erene_football_association;60865527][b]Official FEFA Announcement: Erene World Cup[/b]

The Federation of Erene Football Association (FEFA) announces the launch of the first (to my knowledge) Erene World Cup, the intercontinental tournament is bringing together national teams and fans from across Erene. Any nation can ask to register into the tournament freely, by telegramming this account or telegramming [nation]Valddera[/nation]. The tournament also begins in June, roleplay time. Any nation would be free to ask for registering in the tournament before June.

Tournament Format: to ensure a fair and dynamic competition, FEFA has adopted the following structure:
[b]1: Group Stage[/b] - The final amount of teams will be divided into a certain amount of groups depending on the amount of teams, Each group has the Standard point system:
3 points for a win
1 point for a draw
0 points for a loss

Each team plays a certain amount of matches to qualify, and only a few teams can advance into the knockout stages.

[b]2: Knockout Stage[/b] - The teams who advanced from the group stages will enter a single elimination bracket consisting of:
Round of 16
Quarter finals
Semi Finals
Third place Match
Final match

[b]Matches[/b] - A full match schedule, including group allocations, fixture dates and match results with details and scores will be also featured in the tournament.

[b]Want to host the tournament?[/b] - Hosting the tournament has a few rules, you must submit a telegram or an RMB post to this account or [nation]Valddera[/nation], writing on why you should host the tournament, your nation mustn't be at war, Your nation must have atleast 8 stadiums, or you can build ones. And you'd need to tell me the names of the cities that the tournament will be played at, and the name of the stadiums too.

[b]Group stage slots:[/b] https://postimg.cc/30GrxLm9

[i]The slots can increase depending on how many nations will join.[/i]

[b]Optional requirements[/b]: if you want realism, you can choose to make an entire 11 squad, three substitute players and submit it through a telegram to this account or [nation]Valddera[/nation]. You must also include the number of the players and what position they play.

[b]International Announcement -  Dawn of Greater Tirakan[/b]

Ladies and Gentlemen,
Esteemed Delegates of all sovereign states of Erene,

In Tirakan we say that the morning and victory is near. Today the morning came. 

Tirakan stands united again.

Following the coordinated agreement of the Coastal Alliance governeurs, the independent towns, and a successful popular vote held in every district of the former warzones, the territories once divided by conflict have been restored into a single nation. Beginning today, the country will formally be known as Greater Tirakan. Administrative unification procedures are underway and will be completed within the coming week.

The former authorities of the Holy League have collapsed and been rendered non-functional. The former leader of the Renaissance Union, General Velir, has been captured; a national vote will determine whether he is to be exiled, imprisoned for life, or publicly executed for his actions. King Rhes and several members of the old RU command structure remain missing, though the likelihood of organized resistance is considered low.

The armed forces of the RU and HL have been fully seized and integrated. Over ninety percent of their soldiers have chosen to join the new centralized Greater Tirakan Army. Their air force and navy have also been transferred peacefully into national control.

All religions, including Aelirianism, will be permitted throughout the country. The end of sectarian governance is expected to eliminate the conditions that once fueled extremism and terrorism.

With unity restored, our economy is already accelerating. Steel factories and industrial rigs are resuming full output. Reconstruction contracts, infrastructure renewal, and new technocratic institutions are driving rapid growth. We openly invite the world to invest in Greater Tirakan. Our markets are expanding, our industries are stabilizing, and the nation is ready to rejoin global trade as a reliable and rising economic power.

[i]Emergency wartime laws will now be transferred[/i] into the new technocratic-democratic constitution of Greater Tirakan, ensuring stability, competency, and civilian oversight. National elections will be held in one month.

We're back.
‎ 
‎ 
[i]Acting Premier Arlan Vo[/i]s
